title: TPA100
description: A simple system to send and accept teleport requests.
body:
# ✈️ TPA100

**TPA100** is a modern and lightweight teleport request plugin made exclusively for **Paper** servers running **Minecraft 1.20.1+**.

Send teleport requests, invite players to teleport to you, and manage everything through a clean and simple system designed for modern Minecraft servers.

## ✨ Features

### 👥 Teleport Request System

TPA100 allows players to safely request teleportation without giving instant access.

Players can:
- Request to teleport to another player
- Request another player to teleport to them
- Accept requests
- Deny requests

Everything is simple, fast, and multiplayer-friendly.

### ⏳ Smooth Teleportation

Teleportation includes a configurable **3-second countdown** to keep gameplay balanced and fair.

The countdown duration can be fully customized in the config.

### 🔕 Request Muting

Players can disable incoming teleport requests using a simple toggle command.

When muted:
- Nobody can send teleport requests
- Privacy is fully respected
- Perfect for AFK players, builders, or private gameplay

Running the command again re-enables requests.

### 🔊 Audio Feedback

Teleportation uses the classic **XP Orb Pickup** sound effect for a more satisfying experience.

Sounds can be enabled or disabled in the configuration.

### 🧠 Lightweight & Modern

TPA100 focuses on:
- Performance
- Simplicity
- Modern Paper support
- Clean gameplay experience

No unnecessary features or bloated systems.

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/tpa <player>` | Request to teleport to a player |
| `/tpahere <player>` | Request a player to teleport to you |
| `/tpayes <player>` | Accept a teleport request |
| `/tpano <player>` | Deny a teleport request |
| `/tpamute` | Toggle incoming teleport requests |

## ⚙️ Configuration

TPA100 keeps configuration simple and easy to manage.

```yml
# How many seconds the player will have to wait after starting the teleportation
teleport-countdown: 3

# Play sounds during teleportation
enable-sounds: true
```

## 🚀 Planned Features

TPA100 is actively evolving with many planned improvements, including:

- ⚔️ Combat restrictions to prevent escaping PvP or dangerous situations
- 🚶 Movement detection during teleport countdowns
- 🖥️ GUI-based request management
- 🔒 Permission support
- 🛠️ Continued optimization and bug fixes
- 📦 Support for future Minecraft versions
- 🌍 Open-source release planned on GitHub
